# Missed the Form 5500 deadline? See what it costs to fix it.

> Free Form 5500 late filing calculator for 401(k) and retirement-plan sponsors: the due date with weekend rollover and the Form 5558 extension, days late, and the DOL DFVC programme cost beside IRS and DOL penalty exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [When is Form 5500 due, and what if you missed it?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/form-5500-late-filing-calculator/when-is-form-5500-due.html)
